dict.string: Ember reads your sleep analysis from Apple Health to personalize your wind-down and sleep-efficiency plans automatically, instead of asking you to log every night by hand.
Ember does not write to Apple Health.
Ember reads your upcoming events so it can pre-adapt your rest plan around late nights, early meetings, and travel before they disrupt your sleep.
